# BTicino C300X Integration v2.9.0b1

## 2026-11-22

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/oliver7557)

Beta for firmware 3.0.6, not yet tested on a device. On firmware 1.7.x and
2.0.2 it works like 2.8.2. Includes the bounded RTSP recovery and exact
firewall restoration from 2.8.2. Device/model detection is not part of this beta.

## Display

- **Home Assistant pages on firmware 3.0.6** (beta): the Display patch now
  works on the Qt 5 display of 3.0.6, whose display files are built into the
  vendor program. The home page gets the Alarm and Home Assistant buttons, with
  the Alarm, Home Assistant and Energy pages and the other pages of the
  integration. Switching the optional pages off retains the core display
  hooks; full removal restores the vendor startup script. The touch fix for
  lost taps is not part of it on 3.0.6.
- **Activation and recovery:** apply checks the resources, preload library and
  startup wrapper even when QML is unchanged. Runtime-only agent updates also
  refresh the preload. Failed changes roll back the activation files and their
  quarantine state together, keeping recovery copies if rollback cannot finish.
- **Quarantine:** an error exit within the first minute starts the stock
  display and disables the overlay. Updates and partial restores do not retry
  it. Installation/settings do not report this fallback as successful
  activation; display follow-up remains pending. Investigate the status and
  log before full removal and an explicit retry.

Offline resource-loading and failure-injection checks do not prove device
readiness, vendor C++ signal compatibility or watchdog safety. Cold boot,
fallback/recovery, calls, touch and the Qt 4 regression checks remain device
pre-merge gates. A running GUI process is not proof that every page loaded.

## Install

1. Back up Home Assistant.
2. Enable **Pre-release** for this repository in Marketplace, or beta versions
   in HACS (**Redownload**), and install 2.9.0b1.
3. Run the agent update Repair, then switch on **Home Assistant pages on the
   display** under **Configure > Display > Display and Display patch**. The
   display restarts once.

To go back on firmware 3.0.6, first remove the **complete** overlay with the
beta's `qml_patch.sh restore-all`, and confirm that `qt5_overlay` is `off` and
the stock display is running. Switching off the optional pages alone is not
enough. Only then install the stable release and run its agent update Repair:
stable 2.8.2 does not contain the Qt 5 overlay or its recovery code.

## Feedback

Please report how the display behaves: whether the buttons and pages appear,
whether taps and pages work, and whether calls and messages still work as
before. Attach the Display patch status, the integration diagnostics and, if
you can reach the device, `/tmp/c300x-display-qt5.log`. Details:
[Display patch on firmware 3.0.6](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.9.0b1/docs/advanced-maintenance.md#display-patch-on-firmware-306).
